_comment: Per-game deterministic state hooks for tools/screenshot.js --state=<id>. Each hook is a JavaScript expression evaluated in the page context that drives the page into a named state and returns true on success. Hooks must be deterministic — no reliance on random timing. Add new games here; screenshot.js needs no change. A page with only INIT has no simple deterministic gameplay state (drag-only or continuous-action games), so only its default capture is part of the battery.

animals.PLAY: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('recogToggle'); if (!t) return false; t.click(); return document.getElementById('recogWrap').style.display === 'flex'; })()

animal_counting.PLAY: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.count-tile'); if (!t) return false; t.click(); return t.classList.contains('counted'); })()

animal_memory.PLAY: (() => { const c = document.querySelector('.card'); if (!c) return false; c.click(); return c.classList.contains('flipped'); })()
animal_memory.SUCCESS: (() => { const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.card')); const a = cards[0]; const b = a && cards.find(c => c !== a && c.dataset.name === a.dataset.name); if (!b) return false; a.click(); b.click(); return cards.some(c => c.classList.contains('matched')); })()

animal_puzzle.PLAY: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('puzzlePeek'); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return document.getElementById('puzzlePreviewOverlay').hidden === false; })()

classroom.PLAY: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.activity-btn[data-activity="shapes"]'); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return !!document.querySelector('.class-tab'); })()

compare.PLAY: (() => { const s = window.__compare && window.__compare.state(); if (!s) return false; if (s.mode === 'same') { const b = document.querySelector('.cmp-answer'); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; } const g = document.getElementById('cmp-group-a'); if (!g) return false; g.click(); return true; })()

sorting.PLAY: (() => { const i = document.querySelector('.sort-item'); if (!i) return false; i.click(); return i.classList.contains('sort-selected'); })()

cat_forest.PLAY: (() => { const hk = window.__catForest; if (!hk) return false; hk.seed(7); hk.place('fish', 0); let g = 0; while (g++ < 400 && !hk.state().cats.some(c => c.phase === 'sitting')) hk.step(50); return hk.state().cats.some(c => c.phase === 'sitting'); })()

phonics.PLAY: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.phonics-choice'); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; })()

shapes.PLAY: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.piece'); if (!p) return false; p.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); const s = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.slot')).find(x => !x.dataset.filled && x.dataset.type === p.dataset.type); if (!s) return false; s.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true })); return s.dataset.filled === '1'; })()

spatial.PLAY: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.spatial-choice'); if (!b) return false; b.click(); return true; })()

piano.PLAY: (() => { const k = document.querySelector('.piano-key'); if (!k) return false; k.click(); return true; })()

rhythm.PLAY: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.rhythm-pad'); if (!p) return false; p.click(); return true; })()

coloring.PLAY: (() => { const s = document.querySelector('.coloring-swatch'); if (!s) return false; s.click(); return document.querySelectorAll('.coloring-swatch.selected').length > 0; })()
